column3: SnapSong AI Music from Photos - Launch
column5:
SnapSong transforms any photo into a complete original song — with real vocals and lyrics — all powered by AI. Users capture or select a photo, and within minutes receive two unique full-length tracks inspired by the image's mood, colors, and story.

What makes SnapSong stand out:
• Turns photos into real, full-length songs in minutes — fast, simple, no musical skills needed
• Built natively with SwiftUI for iOS 26 with polished Liquid Glass design
• Full accessibility: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion
• Song generation in 5 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German
• Live Activities for real-time generation progress on the lock screen
• On-device Creative Intelligence via Apple Foundation Models: analyzes song history to suggest fresh keywords, detect repetitive patterns, and recommend unexplored genres — all privately on-device
• Privacy-first: all songs and photos stored locally on device

While other music AI apps focus on advanced production tools, SnapSong makes creating real music effortless — just a photo and a few keywords are all it takes.
